reviews.text:
I found an injured kitten on Hw6. Not wanting this poor kitten to be run over I stopped and picked it up. I took it here trying to do the humane thing. They told me that in order to accept the kitten I had to take financial responsibility for this kitten. That it would be 300 bucks to put it down. So I asked well its not my cat and I dont have 300 to put up. All they did was show me the door. I tried to leave the kitten under a tree outside their facility and before I new two of the staff members came out yelling at me saying " We have your plates and are calling the police" To wich I replied I tried to help this kitten and yall just pointed to the door and said that there was nothing they could do.  So now I was the bad guy for trying to help a defenseless animal.  I finally asked for a box to put the kitten in so I could try elsewhere to find help for this kitten.
My question would be to the owners and the staff of Elite Animal Hospital. Why get into this line of work? To help animals or make money? I understand that there are alot of people who try and act like an animal is not theirs and just drop off so they dont have to deal with the financial responsibility. But I have a vet bill for my dog from 2 days prior to this incident that shows I paid 400 for my dog. This So called animal Hospital made me lose alot of hope on what to do if you come upon and injured animal. Walk away because its not your problem? Or help and get stuck with the financial responsibility. I thought they would al least try and help.
Too early to say much but not bad
Staff were very patient, accommodating, and knowledgeable when examining my dog when I brought him in for a check up. Highly recommend.
Dr. Maduro is an amazing doctor and I love how everyone there is kind and caring... Aubrey is wonderful
I and my pets just love Dr Meduru and the staff. Great vet clinic. Highly recommend
Brianna does a superb job on our Lil’ Bits nails. We appreciate the team at Elite Animal Hospital.

This place I would recommend to anyone and everyone! The staff is ALWAYS very pleasant, attentive, and incredibly caring. My dogs got injured suddenly and the staff got me in immediately and were extremely kind and gentle with my scared/injured dogs. We used to go to a different vet down the road but will now continue our dogs vet care with Elite after such a great experience!
Dr Meduru was knowledgeable and helpful. He understands when his customers need to keep costs down. My house cat has a sprain probably.
Very happy with the service at this clinic. Very friendly staff and the doctor is very nice, he takes the time to explain to you what ever the situation may be. I recommend you this clinic.
They are so nice here and do great with my little Emma. Very patient and always explain things really well!

I have been to several veterinary clinics through different moves, and this is absolutely the most phenomenal vveterinarian clinic I have been to. The veterinarian and staff are exceptional, friendly, and attentive! They make you feel like your pet is the most special pet in the clinic and not just a number. The care is individualized, and they all take the time to listen. The first time I visited, my Little Chihuahua had her foot caught in a bed, and when I rushed her in, the veterinarian staff all came out and were quick to help and reassure. From that point on, I have made them my veterinarian clinic! I highly, highly recommend!

We love bringing our dogs here! The staff is so friendly and helpful. Dr. Meduru is incredibly knowledgeable and is excellent at explaining your options and treatment processes. Every time we walk in the staff instantly welcomes our dogs by name and makes them comfortable in a place that was previously seen as scary.
All the staff from reception to the doctor were super friendly and helpful. Saw us on short notice without any issues or surprises along the way.  Will be going back for sure.
